"The older I get, the less I feel the need to be included and understood." 🌻

📎(Day 19/21)

In my initial college days

I tried hard to blend in groups,

I wanted to be included in everything

 And I was for a while.

But I slowly realized that being included came at a cost....

:-)gossiping about others

:-)using language I wasn't comfortable with

 :-)and bunking classes just to fit the group

so I made a choice

I started spending my free time working on my own things alone

🪻 Learning extras, writing down the thoughts in my diary, growing 

It felt lonely at first

Now it feels peaceful.😌

🌱I am not saying that don't enjoy things!

🌱Neither I am romanticising being alone!

The thing is that...

Don't live with the fomo of "not included"...
Find the suitable place for you first!❤️

Not every group is meant for you

 And that's okay.

🐧What are your views?
~Prachi
